nodes.text: [i]The book is open to a page with nothing on it. The pages around it shiver, as if someone has been holding their breath.[/i]
[i]You lean in. The lantern's light falls into the white space, and the white space falls into you.[/i]
[i]A storybook lies open on the ground, its last page torn out. The words on the pages keep rearranging themselves. You will need something that can rewrite them.[/i]
